notes.title: 🐸Frog Jump - Now with Extra Chaos! (v1.1 Update)
notes.content:
🟢 Difficulty Options
Want a chill bounce or a rage-inducing leap?
Now you can choose:

🐣 Easy

🧍 Normal

💪 Hard

💀 Impossible
[hr][/hr]🏆 Leaderboards by Difficulty
Climb the ranks... separately!
Each difficulty now has its own leaderboard.
Flex your skills where it counts!
[hr][/hr]🔁 Reset Game from Pause Menu
Made a wrong jump? Got stuck in a weird spot?
Now you can fully reset the level straight from the ESC menu — no need to leave the lobby.
One click, clean slate.
[hr][/hr]💦 Low Settings Water Fix
White, glowy water on low settings?
Gone. Your retinas may now relax.
[hr][/hr]🎯 New Achievements
Fresh achievements added for each difficulty.
Complete them all and prove you're the jump master.
